note: Added Oct 20: container queries. A shared component (a card, a panel, a toolbar) adapts to the width of the box it sits in, not the screen, so the same component works in a sidebar and in the main column with no per-page copy (the one-home rule, o11). Use them inside reusable components; keep page-level layout on the layout primitives and a few screen breakpoints. Web only: the Swift side uses its own fit-to-space tools (ViewThatFits, size classes) for the same job. Limit: each container breakpoint is one more state to screenshot and test, so add one only where a component really changes shape.
title: Space with containers, not margins
why: gap on parents, a few layout primitives, clamp() tokens for fluid spacing, and banchi's per-file ratchet. This is the direct fix for centering and gap problems.
